meta_title: Peter McCormack Gardening | Garden Services Liverpool
meta_description: Peter McCormack Gardening Services in Liverpool. Expert garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Local, reliable, friendly service. Call 07779 719080 today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Liverpool Gardener — Design to Maintenance
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces — Peter McCormack handles every job with care and attention to detail.
services_subhead: Whether you need a one-off tidy or a full garden redesign, Peter handles everything from planting to paving.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Custom garden layouts tailored to your space and style. Includes planting schemes, paths, patios, and raised beds to create an outdoor room you'll love.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidying
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, lawn care, and border management keep your garden looking sharp. One-off clears or ongoing weekly visits available.

services.title: Fence & Decking Installation
services.desc: New fence panels, repairs, and decking built to last. All timber treated and installed to withstand Liverpool's weather.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Safe tree felling, crown reduction, and expert pruning. Dead wood removal and waste disposal included; fully insured work.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Laying
services.desc: Level, lasting patios and garden paths in natural stone, block paving, or gravel. Built on proper foundations so they stay put.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Removal
services.desc: Complete overgrown garden clearances with all waste recycled or responsibly disposed of. We haul away the lot.

about_pullquote: I turn neglected outdoor spaces into gardens families actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Peter McCormack has been transforming Liverpool gardens for over 18 years. What started as passion for plants and hard graft has grown into a thriving local reputation — built on turning up on time, doing honest work, and leaving every garden better than he found it. He works across Merseyside, from small courtyard makeovers to large country properties.
about_para_2: Customers keep coming back because Peter listens to what you want, gives straight advice without the sales pitch, and takes genuine pride in the finished result. Whether it's a complete redesign or keeping your borders tidy, he brings the same level of care and attention. No job's too small, and no corner of Liverpool's too far.

reviews.text: Peter transformed our back garden from a complete mess into somewhere we actually want to sit. He was brilliant to deal with — listened to what we wanted, gave sensible suggestions without being pushy, and finished on time. Fair prices too. Couldn't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had an overgrown hedge that was blocking the light. Peter came round, gave a quote on the spot, and had it sorted the following week. Really tidy worker, cleared up all the mess, and the garden looks amazing now. Definitely booking him back for the spring tidy.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: We wanted decking but didn't know where to start. Peter designed it for us, sourced the materials, and built it properly. It's been through a wet winter and still looks solid. He's honest, reliable, and does brilliant work. You won't find better locally.
reviews.author: Claire R.
